lines: Black water wells up through the peat. It is warm, like something breathed into it.

sign: Under Lastbloom the moor flowers into a Rift. Every petal is a name the bog remembers.
petal_keeper: Rosamund: Sabeline has Ashby's book. Every page is a bet on someone's death. Half the bets are on her.
petal_keeper_intro: Rosamund: Your petal is still closed. Let's open it.

lines: Every flower here grew out of someone who trusted the wrong person. Pick one. I will tell you whose it was.
Sabeline: The bloom is closing. The book is yours. Burn it or bet with it, both are traditions here.
Sabeline: Nell is waiting in town with a lamp. Walk beside her, not behind her.

sabeline_intro: Every flower here grew out of someone who trusted the wrong person. Pick one. I will tell you whose it was.
sabeline_defeat: Take the Rift. The bloom closes tonight. Whatever is still standing in it stays for next year.
